steps: Install the AppNana app from the official Google Play listing (or the App Store on iOS).
Register with a correct email address — reward gift codes are sent to your inbox.
Complete tasks from Nana Offers (install apps, play games, watch videos) to earn Nanas.
Open the app every day — you get 400 Nanas just for coming back.
Optionally invite friends with your code for extra Nanas.
When you have enough Nanas, redeem for a gift card (Amazon, iTunes, Google Play, Xbox, PlayStation, Roblox, and more; availability varies by country).
Wait up to 48 hours for the gift code to arrive in your email.
